author: Forbes
description:
In this flagship episode of The Under 30 Podcast, hosts Alex York and Zoya Hasan sit down for a transparent conversation with master barber and entrepreneur Vic Blends. He shares his incredible business trajectory, going from cutting hair in his mom's garage to styling global icons like Barack Obama and Tom Brady. Beyond the viral milestones, Vic opens up about the hidden financial pressures of rapid scaling, including a six-figure IRS bill that nearly derailed his entire operation. 

00:00 Introduction: The Under 30 Interview
01:55 The Origin Of Vic's Motivational Mindset
03:17 Merging Passion & Purpose: The Free Haircut Concept
08:57 From High School Culture To Choosing The Barber Trade
14:29 Scaling The Business: Entertainment Agencies & Mentorship
25:29 The Media Play: "Deep Cut" & Securing A-List Guests
32:41 The Unseen Cost Of Success: Navigating Bipolar 1
39:27 The Six-Figure Financial Mistake You Need To Avoid
49:02 Corporate Social Responsibility: The First Prison Barber Acad
title: From Mom’s Garage To Global Fame: How VicBlends Built A Cultural Barbering Empire
